subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine recovery archives be silently deleted after a fixed retention count of five, and if so what recovery/diagnostic contract must accompany that deletion?
rationale: The implementation makes a new irreversible data-retention policy for files created during cron recovery; source and tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot determine whether deleting those artifacts matches product and operator expectations.

options.title: Approve bounded retention with a recovery contract
options.body: Accept a defined retention policy only after documenting that old quarantine archives are disposable and providing the intended diagnostic or operator recovery behavior.

options.title: Keep recovery archives until a policy is chosen
options.body: Retain the bounded reader and overflow archive rotation but remove destructive pruning until maintainers choose a supported cleanup policy.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded retention with a recovery contract
recommendation.body: Accept a defined retention policy only after documenting that old quarantine archives are disposable and providing the intended diagnostic or operator recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available discussion identifies this person as the most likely reviewer for the unresolved retention-policy choice.
